answers.tankbuster.magic: a defensive that reduces magic damage

Rav'i: [위치] Right after Ravenous Stomp, check which pile didn't get Fresh Meat
[위치] Before 0 energy, move the boss next to the empty pile to prevent Feeding Frenzy

[탱버] Hydrastrike is Physical damage from 3 heads striking in a row. Melee swings and Hydrastrike are the whole tank threat on this boss, so tanks with weak physical mitigation should have a defensive ready (Topicx)
[위치] Move the boss in short steps to leave room for the Triple Shot spread and dodging Regurgitate
The Writhing Coil: [탱버] Tail Scythe is a single Physical hit with a 3 sec cast, so pop physical mitigation before the cast
[위치] Face the boss so the knockback doesn't push you into the party or onto puddles
[위치] Tank near the room edge to bait Vindictive Onslaught into the wall. In the middle of the room the boss flies across it and melee lose uptime (Topicx)
[차단] The tank joins the rotation for the 3 Toxic Atrophy interrupts too
[위치] During Uncoil, kite the 5 Uncoiled Writhe into one spot and stun them so they take AoE damage (Topicx)
Zul'jan: [탱버] Chop Down is a heavy physical double hit, so have mitigation ready before the cast
[참고] Each Chop Down clears 2 stacks of the tank's Ritual Venom and leaves a blood pool at your feet. You get two between Rituals, so 8 stacks drop to 4 (Topicx)
[참고] Clear the remaining stacks by brushing a passing Axegrinder axe on purpose (Topicx, Icy Veins)
[위치] Once the 3 Axegrinder axes are done, drag the boss to an edge so blood pools pile up outside and the central X lines stay clear (Topicx)

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Bedrock Slam comes right after the Lightblossom Beam soaks, so pop your mitigation before it.
[위치] Stack the three bosses together so the party can cleave them.
[위치] Move the bosses out of the Fertile Loam created by Bedrock Slam to keep space for the party.
[위치] Position the bosses where growing flowers and Light-Scorched Earth won't block the party's movement.
[위치] Tank the bosses near a Fertile Loam so you can step in and soak the Lightblossom Beam too.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [위치] Before Verdant Stomp, drag the boss out of the root patch so the area behind you is clear for the knockback. The party stacks near the boss.
[위치] Bring the boss close to allies rooted by Bloodthorn Roots so the party cleaves the roots too.
[참고] When Bloodthirsty Gaze ends, pick the boss back up and bring it near the roots.
[탱버] Use a defensive when Thorncaller Roar overlaps the post-50% Frenzy AoE damage.
Lightwarden Ruia: [탱버] In Bear Form, Mangling Claws doubles melee damage, so keep your mitigation buff up without gaps.
[차단] Interrupt Warden's Wrath cast at you in Moonkin Form to reduce tank damage.
[참고] Pulverizing Strikes never targets the tank (Topicx). Leave room around the boss for the marked players to spread.
[탱버] Use a big defensive during the 40% Spirits of the Vale phase.
Ziekket: [탱버] Pop your mitigation buff for the Thornspike cast.
[위치] Gather summoned Lashers quickly so the party can AoE them down.
[참고] If the Thornspike knockback moves you, regroup the Lashers and the boss.
[위치] When Lashers spawn, walk into the middle of them and grab aggro first. Lightspore Shot usually targets the tank (Topicx).
[참고] Soak only about three Lightbloom's Essence orbs so you keep your health for Thornspike (Topicx).
[위치] Keep the boss and adds near the platform edge, but backing all the way to the right edge pulls the Overgrown Hydra (Method, Topicx).

The Hoardmonger: [위치] Before Resourceful Measures, drag the boss near the resource pile you want to set the empowerment order.
[위치] Unless you are feeding a resource pile, keep the boss in the middle of the room (Topicx).
[위치] Step on 3-4 mushrooms every time to spare the party poison stacks. Four stacks are survivable, so a late dispel is fine (Topicx).
[회피] Move the boss into open space away from Bonespike Slam spike puddles.
[참고] This boss has no big tank-targeted hit (Topicx).
Sentinel of Winter: [위치] Stand the boss near a Fractured Shivercore so tank and melee cleave the boss and that add together. Ranged take the other add (Topicx).
[위치] Before Frozen Tempest, move the boss onto the snow pile where the add died so you don't get pushed.
[회피] Keep the boss out of the Raging Squall path to give the party room to dodge.
[위치] Do not drag the boss to the wall. Adds spawning on the edge snow and ice are hard to kill, and hugging the wall can reset the boss (Topicx).
Nalorakk: [위치] Before Overwhelming Onslaught, turn the boss so there are no Echoes behind the tank.
[탱버] The three armor-ignoring Physical hits of Overwhelming Onslaught hurt the most, so use your defensive here (Topicx, tank-buster sheet).
[탱버] After the knockback, head straight back toward the boss to take the Forceful Slam soak spot.
[참고] Missing Forceful Slam stacks Demoralizing Scream and the rest of the fight falls apart.
[참고] If you are an Echoing Maul target, use a defensive (Topicx).

Kystia Manaheart: [위치] Keep Kystia and Nibbles together so the party cleaves both.
[위치] Turn Nibbles away from the party so Fel Spray doesn't sweep them.
[탱버] Chaos Barrage is Chaos (magic) damage repeated all fight. Each hits for about 20% of your health, so start magic mitigation before a chain to cover two or more hits (Topicx).
[차단] When Mirror Images appear, stop Felstorm immediately with interrupts and stuns.
[참고] The tank can grab the first-area gem (one of five spots) and trade it for the Concealed Pistol at the vendor next to the boss (Topicx).
Zaen Bladesorrow: [위치] After the RP, gather the melee worker packs and line of sight them outside the door. Have a DPS or healer open the door (Topicx).
[위치] Taunt the boss as soon as it appears so it does not run at party members near the workers (Topicx).
[탱버] Worker melee hits hard right at the start, so use a big defensive. Once they die, Envenom is the only real threat (Topicx).
[탱버] Use mitigation and a defensive together for the Envenom cast.
[해제] Heartstop Poison is a poison, so cleanse it right away if you can.
[위치] Keep moving Zaen to safe spots where barrels and bombs won't explode.
Xathuux the Annihilator: [위치] At the arena edge, face the boss outward. Legion Strike follows the tank, so sidestep about 2 sec before the cast so the frontal misses the party (Topicx).
[탱버] Legion Strike is Physical. Top up and use a defensive or get an external.
[탱버] Demonic Rage gives the boss 75% attack speed for 15 sec, so use a defensive.
[참고] Infernal Crush follows right after Axe Toss, so spend your second defensive there (Topicx).
[위치] When Axe Toss lands, move the boss to the axe so both get cleaved.

[위치] During Demonic Rage, back up only as slowly as your melee can keep hitting, covering no more than half the room at once. Old puddles fade, so one slice left after the second Rage is enough (Topicx).
Lithiel Cinderfury: [위치] On pull, drag the boss as far back as possible to the farthest corner to buy time before the Infernal reaches you (Topicx).
[위치] The unkillable Infernal chases the tank the whole fight, so kite it far from the party and the boss.
[회피] Getting close to the Infernal hits you with Felfire Core, so never let it reach you.
[위치] Don't let the Infernal sit between the gates or block a gate entrance.
[탱버] Tank damage spikes when the Furious Vilefiend and adds spawn, so use a defensive. The Vilefiend adds Shadow Bite Shadow damage to its melee (Topicx).
[참고] Adds beyond the fire wall can get pulled through it, so be careful where you fight.

Taz'Rah: [탱버] Void Blast (2s cast, heavy shadow damage + knockback) is a magic tank buster, so use a magic-damage defensive every time.
[위치] Take Void Blast with your back to an open direction so the knockback doesn't push you into puddles.
[위치] Wait in the middle of the room before the boss spawns, then drag it to the wall outside the Ethereal Shades once it lands (Topicx).
[위치] Start at a nearby wall and rotate the boss in only one direction, clockwise or counterclockwise.
[위치] After Umbral Rupture, move the boss away from the newly created Void Fissures.
Atroxus: [탱버] Hulking Claw (2s cast, Nature hit + undispellable 10s Nature DoT) is a magic tank buster, so take it with a magic-damage defensive.
[탱버] Hulking Claw comes often enough that some casts land with no big defensive available. Cover those with a minor defensive, a potion, or self-healing (Topicx).
[회피] Keep kiting so the Toxic Creeper never reaches melee range.
[위치] The Toxic Creeper spawns from the closest poison platform, so fight beside one of the two platforms and move the boss to the other one once the floor gets messy (Topicx).
[위치] If possible, keep the kite path close to the boss so DPS can hit the Creeper and the boss together.
[위치] Pull the boss off Poison Pools so melee DPS don't stand in them.
Charonus: [탱버] Dark Waves (5s cast, big shadow frontal) is a magic tank buster, so save a magic-damage defensive for it. Cosmic Crash doesn't need a tank defensive (Topicx).
[위치] Aim Dark Waves where nobody is, away from the party and the Singularity puddles used to cleanse orbs.

[위치] Stand the boss in front of two Singularities, not in the middle of all three. Melee drag orbs to the two close ones, ranged to the far one, and you can easily turn Dark Waves toward the empty side (Topicx).
[참고] Gravitic Orbs never target the tank (Topicx).

The Golden Serpent: [탱버] Have mitigation ready for every Tail Thrash (Physical). Method rates this ability as low danger
[위치] Tank the boss back on the stairs in the nook so the party drops pools on either side, and keep Animated Gold close enough to cleave but not close enough to touch the boss (Topicx)
[위치] When Animated Gold approaches, drag the boss the other way to prevent contact
[위치] As the fight goes on, slowly move the boss to keep room for new pools
[위치] When the boss is low, slowly drag it toward the exit door; the last set of Animated Gold can be ignored (Topicx)
Mchimba the Embalmer: [위치] Quickly pick up the 2 Half-Finished Mummies and gather them next to the boss
[위치] When a Finished Mummy spawns, pick it up immediately and stack it next to the boss for AoE
[위치] Tank the boss near the middle of the room. On an edge the far coffins are too far away. Don't leave the boss and mummies in front of the coffins (Topicx)
[참고] On Entomb, the tank helps open coffins too; from the middle every coffin is close (Topicx)
The Council of Tribes: [위치] Tank and kill Kula in the middle of the room. Whirling Axes spawn where she dies
[위치] Don't stand with your back to the platform edge so the Backhand knockback doesn't knock you off
[탱버] Use a big defensive for Debilitating Backhand (Physical) and the Shattered Defenses that follows. Without one, kite until Shattered Defenses ends (Topicx, Method)
[탱버] Right after Zanazal engages, Arc Lightning (Nature) hits the tank first and keeps coming periodically. Take it with magic damage reduction (Topicx)
[위치] Drag Zanazal next to the totems so they get AoE'd together
Dazar, The First King: [탱버] Stack your defensives on the moment T'zala's Savage Maul bleed overlaps Blade Combo. P1 barely needs any; spend them elsewhere and you will be dry for the overlap (Topicx)
[위치] Pick up Dazar and Reban together right after the pull
[위치] When T'zala appears at 80%, grab aggro immediately so it doesn't go for the healer
[위치] During Gilded Destruction, turn the boss away from the party

Melidrussa Chillworn: [탱버] If Frigid Shard isn't interrupted, heavy physical damage comes in, so have a defensive ready.
[차단] Kick Frigid Shard yourself right after the Hailburst ice drops, then drag the boss out of the ice. Don't rely on DPS kicks (Topicx).
[위치] Pick up Infused Whelps right away and stack them on the boss for AoE damage.
[해제] At 20 stacks, the Infused Whelp's Cold Claws becomes Frozen Solid, so remove it with a dispel or freedom effect.
[참고] With many whelps, Cold Claws can reach 20 stacks before the healer's dispel is back, so keep a self-cleanse available (Topicx).
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Searing Blows hits 4 times over 3s, each hit stacking a Searing Wounds fire DoT.
[탱버] Searing Blows combines Physical hits with a Fire (magic) DoT, so use a defensive every time and on high keys overlap physical and magic mitigation (Topicx).
[위치] Keep the boss next to the Blazebound Firestorm so both take AoE damage.
[위치] After the Firestorm dies, drag the boss well out of the Scorched Earth patch so you have room to bait Molten Boulder behind you (Topicx).
[차단] Put spare interrupts into Blaze Volley.
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [탱버] Stormslam (2.5s) deals heavy physical+nature damage and applies a stacking 30s 100% nature damage taken increase. Take it with basic mitigation and save defensives for when you get Inferno Spit (Topicx).
[해제] Ask the healer to dispel the magic debuff before the next Stormslam.
[탱버] If the debuff is still up, you also take double nature damage from Interrupting Cloudburst.
[위치] When Kyrakka lands, drag Erkhart next to her so both bosses get hit together.
[위치] In phase 2 the mounted boss can still be dragged around (Topicx).

Adderis & Aspix: [탱버] When Adderis gains Overload, its attack speed doubles for 8 sec and its melee hits add Nature damage, so have a defensive ready. Otherwise tank pressure is low (Topicx).
[위치] Tank both bosses together and hold the same spot after immunity swaps to help DPS switch targets.
[위치] Keep the bosses near the middle of the room. On a wall, everyone has to aim their Gale Force lines the same way and they hit each other (Topicx).
[위치] Keep the bosses near the party for the Thunder and Lightning soak.
[참고] Mark the boss to attack (the one without Storm Blessed) with skull (Topicx).
[위치] When Gale Force pushes you away, use a charge or movement ability to get straight back to the boss (Topicx).
Merektha: [탱버] Line up a defensive or your main mitigation with every Lightning Bite (Physical hit + 7 sec Nature DoT).
[위치] After A Knot of Snakes, gather the scattered snakes in one spot to help AoE them down.
[위치] On Hatch, know where the eggs are and grab the Storm Serpent immediately. If it melees a DPS it is dangerous; the Toxic Vipers are casters and less urgent (Topicx).
[위치] The Storm Serpent leaves puddles with Storm Catalyst, so tank it near existing puddles or at the room edge.
[위치] Move the boss out of Lingering Storm puddles to keep the center clear.
[회피] The Burrow charge circle is small and gives plenty of time, so keep an eye on the boss and you will dodge it (Topicx).
Galvazzt: [위치] Move the boss through the four corners of the room, one per Induction Field. By the fourth puddle the first one is fading (Topicx).
[위치] Position the boss so party members can reach every spire beam path.
[참고] DPS and healers block the beams; the tank does not. Galvanized increases Physical damage taken by 250% (Topicx, Method).
[참고] There is no tank buster. Your only job is positioning the boss (Topicx).
Avatar of Sethraliss: [위치] The purple mark on the floor is where the Corrupted Guardian spawns. Grab aggro fast and tank it in a corner away from the healer and soak paths (Topicx).
[탱버] Line up your main mitigation and a defensive with the Tainted Strike cast (Physical hit + 25 sec Shadow DoT, stacks).

[참고] Don't soak orbs while a Corrupted Guardian is alive: the Corruption Shadow DoT stacks on the Tainted Strike DoT and Physical damage taken goes up 250%. Once the Guardian is dead you can help soak (Topicx).
[위치] When the Twisted Hexxer spawns, grab it and drag it next to the Guardian so the party can cleave them together (Topicx).
[위치] In phase 2, gather the incoming Faithless Tormentors to help AoE them down.
